case: variants are revision-scoped descendants with retained / shortened / removed / new beats
targets: lib/variants.mjs diffBeats / approvalNeeded / variantRecord / invalidate / mutedSafe

checks.name: dispositions
checks.expect: b1 retained, b2 shortened, b3 removed, b4 new; counts 1/1/1/1; claim ids c1 and c2 unchanged

checks.name: new claim needs approval
checks.setup: variant beat carries claim c9 not in the parent
checks.expect: approvalNeeded.needs_approval true, approval_stage story; record status blocked_on_approval; nothing is toggled by export

checks.name: mostly new beats
checks.expect: needs_approval true: a different narrative, not a variant

checks.name: dropped claim is visible
checks.expect: listed in reasons; not itself blocking

checks.name: parent link
checks.expect: record.parent carries story, look, storyboard digests and score revision; profile pin carries id, version, digest

checks.name: shared asset change
checks.expect: only variants listing asset-7 are stale; others keep; accepted exports untouched

checks.name: translation change
checks.expect: only the German variant is stale

checks.name: muted safe
checks.expect: ok false, lost [m1]; no requirement for large redundant headings
